annotation.authors_or_issuer: Radio Televisyen Malaysia (RTM), Berita Ehwal Semasa
annotation.summary_en: RTM news report on the launch of AI Malaysia Berhad, an agency under the Digital Ministry, as a catalyst for Malaysia's national AI agenda toward 2030. A UTM academic says it should reform barriers, build local talent, build public confidence and foster cross-sector collaboration. No robotics content.
annotation.title_clean: AI Malaysia Berhad perkukuh ekosistem kecerdasan buatan negara
annotation.title_en: AI Malaysia Berhad strengthens the national artificial intelligence ecosystem
key_provisions_or_claims: AI Malaysia Berhad launched by PM Anwar Ibrahim as an agency under the Ministry of Digital
Continues the agenda from the 2021 National AI Roadmap and NAIO
Expected to act as catalyst agency and remove systemic barriers for 'Made by Malaysia' AI
Should strengthen local talent and build public confidence in AI
Promotes cross-ministry, industry and education collaboration
